this.winOverlay = document.getElementById('win-overlay');\n    this.settingsOverlay = document.getElementById('settings-overlay');\n\n    // Game state\n    this.levels = [];\n    }\n    }\n\n    // Add exits at road ends\n    const exits = [\n      { x: gridCols - 1, y: centerY },\n      { x: 0, y: centerY }\n    ];\n\n    this.levels = [{\n      id: 'daily',\n
